validation.receipt: Parent-shared tool transcript; runtime changes since this check are semicolon/style corrections only.

scope.grouping: Fixed groups of four consecutive term banks, not a claim to reproduce production browser source scheduling.
scope.parity: Every term content/key/lookup column and normalized projected/fallback media output, including exact diagnostic bytes/spans/decoded strings, matches baseline.
scope.serialization: Node V8 serialize() lengths of the media portion of each result, summed across groups; not browser wire bytes, latency, total import time, or process memory.
scope.objectCounts: Unique object, array, typed-array-view, and Map instances reachable from each media payload, summed across groups. Excludes strings and underlying backing-buffer objects; does not count all temporary allocations.
